description:
BlueCross BlueShield of Tennessee (a taxpaying, not-for-profit health plan) is hiring a Workforce AI Engineer . 
 
 In this fully remote role, you'll influence the direction of enterprise AI solutions that boost workforce productivity and innovation. You’ll be a senior technical voice for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI services, and related tools, helping shape how we approach AI governance, security, compliance, and responsible adoption. 

 Along the way, you’ll partner with business and technology teams, mentor engineers and citizen developers, and turn great AI ideas into scalable solutions that support the 3.4 million members and communities we serve .

 Ideal candidates will bring:
 Subject matter expertise in M365 Copilot, Power Platform, and Power tools 
 Strong understanding of cloud technologies, security, governance, and service operations with a customer-focused mindset
 Change management experience
 Experience working on enterprise collaboration, productivity, or workplace technology platforms
 
 Notes: 
 Sponsorship is not available for this role.
 Although this is a remote opportunity, final onsite interviews at our Chattanooga, TN, headquarters will be required.
 We are unable to hire candidates living in California, New York, New Jersey, New Hampshire, and Massachusetts.
 
 Job Responsibilities 
 Identify root cause and provide documentation on outage details and customer impact.
 Respond to application degradations/outages and lead outage calls to restore service.
 Performs capacity planning for end-user environments, including virtual.
 Working with third party service providers to ensure end to end support is maintained as required.
 Must be willing to adjust schedule to perform maintenance and upgrades outside of business hours and be part of an on-call rotation.
 
 Job Qualifications 
 Education 
 Bachelors degree in Computer Information Systems or a related field, or commensurate experience in a professional environment, required.
 
 Experience 
 5 years - Experience in Information Technology required
 1 year - Experience in IT engineering in an enterprise environment.
 
 Skills\Certifications 
 Knowledge of infrastructure technologies including workstations, networking, storage, virtualization and the integration between these systems.
 Excellent oral and written communication skills
 Strong interpersonal and organizational skills
 Proven decision making and problem solving skills
 Excellent time and project management skills
 Positive attitude, self-driven, engaging, proactive, results drive
 
 
 Number of Openings Available 
1 
 Worker Type: 
Employee 
 Company: 
BCBST BlueCross BlueShield of Tennessee, Inc.

 BCBST's EEO Policies/Notices

All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at BlueCross BlueShield of Tennessee via-email, the Internet or any other method without a valid, written Direct Placement Agreement in place for this position from BlueCross BlueShield of Tennessee HR/Talent Acquisition will not be considered. No fee will be paid in the event the applicant is hired by BlueCross BlueShield of Tennessee as a result of the referral or through other means.
